title: Governance
description: Who may do what, and what data may go where.
arrives: Segregation of duties and the bank-detail control

matrix.title: Role and permission matrix
matrix.description: Each cell is a row in the live role-permission table. A change is saved at once and written to the audit log.
matrix.readOnly: You can read the matrix. Changing it needs the roles.manage permission.
matrix.dataScopeHint: Which records a role may see. The base stores and shows this; area 4 enforces it.
matrix.emptyDescription: The role table is empty. Restart the API to load the default roles.

copy.title: Copy a role's permissions
copy.description: Makes the target hold exactly what the source holds, with the same data scope. A copy that would break a locked cell is refused, so copying onto the system admin only works from a role that never approves, posts or pays.

users.title: Users
users.description: Users are disabled, never deleted, so the audit trail keeps its names.
users.name: Name
users.emptyDescription: Users appear here once they exist.
users.forbiddenDescription: Your role does not include the users.read permission.

masking.title: Masking
masking.description: The server decides what each role sees. A hidden value is never sent, so it is not in the page or the network tab. This is one neutral sample rule; the real rules are area 4's.
masking.recordsLabel: Synthetic customers with the sample rule applied
masking.emptyDescription: The synthetic customers could not be listed.

ai.title: Data sent to AI
ai.description: The AI gateway asks this rule before it sends anything. The default is synthetic data only, so real data goes nowhere until area 4 says otherwise.
ai.emptyDescription: The rule list is empty, which means nothing may be sent.

refusals.title: How a refusal looks
refusals.description: A refused action is the same everywhere. The server answers 403 with a short message and a trace id. The reason goes to the audit log, so someone probing learns nothing about the rules.
refusals.exampleDescription: Your role does not include this action. If you think it should, ask a system admin and quote the trace id.

badges.mock: The masking sample uses synthetic customers.
